Extract a fitted model from a topic-count comparison

Source: R/compare.R
fitted.sbert_topic_sweep.Rd

fitted() returns one candidate model from a compare_topics() comparison, identical to a topics() fit with the same settings, without fitting it again. compare_topics() fits a model for every candidate number of topics and, by default, keeps them, so once a candidate has been chosen from the comparison its model can be taken out directly.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'sbert_topic_sweep'
fitted(object, n_topics, segment = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

A comparison returned by compare_topics() with keep_models = TRUE (the default).

n_topics

The number of topics of the model to return; one of the candidates.

segment

The segment level of the model to return, when the comparison spans several levels; NULL (default) for a single-level comparison.

...

Ignored.

Value

A topic model of class sbert_topic_model, as returned by topics().

Conditions

Errors of class sbert_no_fitted_model when the comparison kept no models or holds no model for n_topics, and sbert_bad_input when segment is given for a single-level comparison or missing for a comparison of several levels.

See also

compare_topics(); summary() for the most coherent candidate.

Examples

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
comparison <- compare_topics(corpus, n_topics = c(4, 6),
                             column = "translation",
                             embeddings = feedback_embeddings)
topic_model <- fitted(comparison, n_topics = 6)
topic_sizes(topic_model, weights = "n")
